result.summary: Hessler Maschinenbau currently has one open overdue invoice of USD 640,000, now 52 days past due date 2026-10-02, reported by policy TCI-EX-2026-0001 under the sole insurer TCI. Prior resolved overdues show lengthening delays (9 days late in March, 19 days late in June), and the current unresolved overdue at 52 days continues this worsening pattern. Combined outstanding (640k overdue + 2.6M not-yet-due) of 3.24M now exceeds the 3.0M credit limit on the single reporting policy, warranting a limit review.
